garantiya.title: IN WOOD door warranty — terms for dealers and partners
garantiya.heading: Warranty
garantiya.intro: We stand behind the quality of every door that leaves our production — from materials to hardware. Below are the warranty terms for dealers and export partners.

sections.title: Standard warranty
sections.text: IN WOOD interior doors carry a 1-year warranty from the shipment date. The warranty covers manufacturing and material defects, provided storage, transport and installation guidelines are followed.

sections.title: Hardware warranty
sections.text: The warranty on hardware (hinges, locks, handles, etc.) is set by the hardware manufacturer under its own warranty terms and is stated in the accompanying documentation for the batch.

sections.title: Warranty conditions
sections.text: The warranty applies provided the recommendations on storage, transport, installation and use are followed. A warranty claim requires the supply agreement and invoice.

sections.title: Warranty repair
sections.text: If a defect is found within the warranty period, the partner contacts their manager or calls +38 050 880 38 41 to file a claim report. Repair or replacement is free of charge unless the defect results from a breach of transport or use conditions.

garantiya.procedureIntro: To file a warranty claim, the partner provides:
procedure: the contract or delivery note number
a description of the defect with photo evidence
the date and circumstances of the defect discovery
exclusions: damage caused by a breach of transport or storage rules
damage caused by factors beyond the manufacturer's control (room humidity, improper installation, etc.)
garantiya.ctaText: Have questions about warranty terms or want to file a warranty claim? Leave your contacts — our manager will get in touch and advise on next steps.
garantiya.metaDescription: IN WOOD interior door warranty terms for dealers and partners — coverage, duration and the claims process.

faq.title: FAQ about IN WOOD doors
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about IN WOOD interior doors — manufacturing, sizes, materials, installation and warranty.

items.q: How long does it take to manufacture IN WOOD interior doors?
items.a: Standard interior doors take 30 days to manufacture. Custom sizes take 45 days.

items.q: What are the standard sizes of IN WOOD interior doors?
items.a: Width: 400–900 mm; height: 1800–2100 mm.

items.q: Does IN WOOD make interior doors in custom sizes?
items.a: Yes — we manufacture doors in non-standard sizes: width — 950, 1000 mm; height — 2150, 2200, 2250, 2300 mm (50 mm steps). Non-standard sizes carry a +20% surcharge on the panel price.

items.q: How do I correctly measure the door opening before ordering?
items.a: Measure the width, height and wall thickness at several points, since the opening may be uneven. For an accurate order, we recommend using a professional measurement service that will account for all installation details.

items.q: When is the best time to install interior doors during a renovation?
items.a: Interior doors are recommended to be installed at the final stage of renovation — after finishing the walls, ceiling and floor. This helps avoid damage to the door leaves and ensures accurate installation of casings and hardware.

items.q: Can interior doors be installed after the renovation is finished?
items.a: Yes, installing interior doors after the renovation is complete is possible. The main requirement is that the door openings are prepared to the required dimensions and the walls and floor have finished surfaces.

items.q: What materials are IN WOOD interior doors made of?
items.a: IN WOOD interior doors are made with a frame of solid wood and MDF.

items.q: Which door finish is better: PVC film or paint?
items.a: The choice of finish depends on usage conditions and the desired design. PVC-film finish is practical, moisture-resistant and easy to maintain. Painted doors have a more premium look, a wide colour palette, and allow more complex design solutions.

items.q: What's the difference between panel and stile-and-rail ("tsarga") interior doors?
items.a: Panel doors have a solid construction with a smooth surface or decor (moulding, milling, mirror inserts, etc.). Stile-and-rail doors are made by joining solid-wood vertical stiles of the door leaf together with horizontal rails (tsargas). IN WOOD's entire range is panel construction.

items.q: How thick are IN WOOD interior doors?
items.a: IN WOOD manufactures interior doors in 34 mm and 40 mm thickness.

items.q: What filling is used inside interior doors?
items.a: IN WOOD panel doors are filled with a fine-cell honeycomb infill (18 mm cell), which ensures uniformity, flatness and rigidity of the door leaf.

items.q: Are IN WOOD interior doors resistant to moisture and damage?
items.a: Sealed leaf edges and an aluminium edge trim provide extra protection against moisture and damage.

items.q: Does the door finish fade or lose colour in the sun?
items.a: IN WOOD door finishes are resistant to sunlight.

items.q: Can IN WOOD interior doors be painted in any colour from the RAL and NCS catalogues?
items.a: IN WOOD can paint doors in any colour available in the RAL / NCS catalogues.

items.q: Can I order interior doors taller than 2100 mm?
items.a: The maximum door leaf height is 2300 mm (2150–2300 mm for an additional fee).

items.q: What are flush (hidden) installation doors?
items.a: Flush installation doors are interior doors with an aluminium frame that is installed flush with the wall, staying invisible after finishing, with two opening options — standard and inside. Such doors create the effect of a single plane with the wall and complement modern interiors beautifully.

items.q: What are the advantages of flush installation doors?
items.a: Flush installation doors create a modern, minimalist interior look thanks to being installed flush with the wall. They visually enlarge the space and allow the leaf to be painted or finished in the same style as the walls.

items.q: What hardware does IN WOOD fit its interior doors with?
items.a: IN WOOD fits its interior doors with quality European hardware (handles, hinges, locks), tested and matched to our door models.

items.q: Can I buy just the door leaf, without the frame and casing?
items.a: Yes, at IN WOOD you can purchase just the door leaf, without the accompanying frame and casing set.

items.q: Does IN WOOD install interior doors?

etalon.title: ETALON Doors — 40 mm Interior Doors from IN WOOD Factory
etalon.metaDescription: ETALON collection: 17 models, 17 film colours, 40 mm leaf. Aluminium edging, flush and concealed frames, sound insulation. Quote within one working day.
body: ETALON is the broadest line IN WOOD makes. If you have not yet decided where to start, start here: it has the most models, the widest choice of frames, and options available nowhere else in the range.

The leaf is 40 mm thick — 6 mm more than NOMINAL and FREZZATTI. You will not see the difference in a photo, but you will feel it: the door is heavier, denser, and closes differently. That thickness is also what leaves room for optional sound insulation, which no other line offers. Read more about what the leaf is made of in ["Panel vs. stile-and-rail doors"](/blog/shhytovi-chy-tsargovi-dveri).

**Seventeen models.** ET-01 is a plain leaf with no decor, a base for minimalist interiors. ET-02 to ET-17 carry moulding: from a single vertical line to dense geometric patterns. The leaf colour is chosen from 17 films, from plain white to Stone Cut, Carpathian Spruce and Black Bark.
**Three edge options — effectively three different doors.**
**Standard edge** is finished in PVC film. The most common and most affordable choice.

**Aluminium edging** finishes the edge with a metal profile. It looks more expensive and takes knocks better — the edge is what a trolley, a vacuum cleaner or a child's scooter hits first. The edging comes in black, white, or matched to the leaf.
**INSIDE edging** adds a decorative aluminium inlay on the leaf itself, black or grey. The inlay is chosen separately from the edging, so the combination can be built around a specific interior.

**The widest frame choice in the range.** Beyond the standard telescopic frame, ETALON alone offers a flush frame — the leaf sits level with the wall, with no protruding frame — and a concealed frame, STANDART for plastering or LUX for panelling. With a concealed frame no architrave or extension is needed: the joint is filled and painted together with the wall, and the door reads as no frame at all. The frame itself can be painted to a RAL code. Read more about this option on the ["Concealed doors"](/catalog/pryhovani-dveri) page, and about exact RAL colour matching in the [PERFETTO](/catalog/perfetto) collection.
**Sizes.** Width 400–900 mm, height 1800–2100 mm, in 50 mm steps — no size surcharge within that range. Wider than 900 or taller than 2100 is made to order, up to 1000 and 2300 mm respectively.

perfetto.title: PERFETTO Doors — Minimalist Doors in Any RAL Colour | IN WOOD
perfetto.metaDescription: PERFETTO: two models, 17 film colours or any RAL/NCS shade to order. 40 mm leaf, flush frame available. Quote within one working day.
perfetto.h1: PERFETTO collection — doors in an exact colour
body: PERFETTO is the shortest line in the range and the most expensive. Two models, PF-01 and PF-02. That is by design, not by limitation: the collection is made for interiors where the door should not draw attention with a pattern. Looking for relief and paint together? That's closer to [FREZZATTI](/catalog/frezzatti).
The leaf is 40 mm, as in ETALON, but without mouldings or milling. Everything expressive here lives in the colour and in how the door sits in the wall.

**Take a ready colour or name your own.** The standard version offers the same 17 films as ETALON: concretes, stone, textured wood, black bark. If none of them fits, there is a made-to-order option: you give a RAL or NCS code and the leaf is painted in exactly that shade. The door then matches the wall, the cornice or the furniture precisely rather than approximately. See ["How to Match Door Colour with Flooring and Furniture"](/blog/yak-pidibraty-kolir-dverei-pid-pidlohu) for more on choosing a colour.
Worth knowing in advance: made-to-order shades have no finished colour photograph, only an indicative sample, and production takes longer than standard. That is the fair price of precision.

**Flush frame.** In PERFETTO it is available alongside the telescopic frame, and it is where the collection comes into its own: the leaf sits in the same plane as the wall, with no protruding frame. The architrave for a flush frame is flat as well. If you want to go further and remove the frame entirely, look at [concealed doors](/catalog/pryhovani-dveri).
**Sizes.** Width 400–900 mm, height 1800–2100 mm in 50 mm steps, with no size surcharge in that range.

frezzatti.title: FREZZATTI Milled Doors — Relief Patterns and RAL Colours | IN WOOD
frezzatti.metaDescription: FREZZATTI: 14 milled models, 12 film colours or painted to any RAL/NCS code. 34 mm leaf. Quote within one working day.
body: In FREZZATTI the pattern is not applied to the leaf — it is cut into it. The cutter removes material and the relief becomes part of the door: unlike [moulding](/catalog/etalon), it cannot peel off or be knocked loose by a corner of furniture.
Fourteen models, from one or two lines to dense geometry across the whole leaf. Thickness 34 mm.

**Two ways to get the colour.** The first is to choose from 12 ready films: white, anthracite, feldgrau, three oxides, several oaks, wenge. The colour is known in advance and production runs to standard lead times.

The second is to give a RAL or NCS code. The leaf is then painted to order, and the frame, architrave and extension can be painted to match — the door reads as a single mass with no foreign parts. This is the option usually chosen when there is a design project with specified colours. A smooth leaf with the same precise RAL painting is available in the [PERFETTO](/catalog/perfetto) collection.

One thing worth understanding: painted relief reads differently from film. Matt paint casts a soft shadow in the grooves; film gives a sharper, glossier line. If the pattern is what matters most to you, that is an argument for paint. See ["How to choose interior doors"](/blog/yak-obraty-mizhkimnatni-dveri) for the bigger picture.
**The frame** is telescopic, 80, 100 or 120 mm. For RAL/NCS models the frame, architrave and extension are supplied as separate painted items.
**Sizes.** Width 400–900 mm, height 1800–2100 mm in 50 mm steps, no surcharge within that range.

nominal.title: NOMINAL Doors — Practical Range from the Manufacturer | IN WOOD
nominal.metaDescription: NOMINAL: 10 models, 12 colours, 34 mm leaf. A rational choice for rental flats, offices and large orders. Quote within a day.
body: NOMINAL is the line for situations where doors should look good and last, without being the main feature of the interior. A rental flat, an office, a hotel, a hall of residence, a multi-storey house where there are many doors and every extra thousand per set is multiplied by ten. See ["Who orders interior doors"](/blog/hto-zamovliaie-mizhkimnatni-dveri) for more on who typically chooses this line.

The leaf is 34 mm, with ten models: NL-01 without decor and NL-02 to NL-10 with moulding. Twelve colours — white, anthracite, feldgrau, three oxides, oaks, southern wenge. A working set that covers most interiors without overthinking.

**Honestly about the difference from ETALON.** The leaf is thinner, there are fewer models and colours, there is no aluminium edging, no flush or concealed frame, and no sound insulation option. The frame is telescopic only, 80, 100 or 120 mm.

These are not "worse doors" — they are a different set of possibilities at a different price. Structurally the leaf is the same: MDF, factory preparation, hardware cut in at the plant. If you need quiet in a bedroom or a flush frame, look at [ETALON](/catalog/etalon). If you need reliable doors in quantity without paying for options you will not use, NOMINAL is the answer.

**For projects.** Large orders have separate terms — fitting out new developments, hotels and offices. Write to us with the number of doors and we will price it for the volume. Terms for dealers and developers are on the ["Partnership"](/spivpratsya) page.

**Sizes.** Width 400–900 mm, height 1800–2100 mm in 50 mm steps, no surcharge within that range. Convenient when openings across a building differ: there is no need to rebuild the wall to fit the door.

pryhovani-dveri.title: Concealed Doors — Hidden Frame Doors from the Factory | IN WOOD
pryhovani-dveri.metaDescription: IN WOOD concealed doors: 40 mm leaf ready for painting, STANDART frame for plaster or LUX for panelling. Own production, quote within a day.
body: An ordinary door is always visible — even closed, it stays a frame on the wall. A concealed door removes that frame completely: the frame hides inside the wall, the joint is filled and painted along with it, and what remains is a wall with a barely visible line along the edge.

The leaf is 40 mm MDF with no finish — it is painted after installation, in the same paint as the walls. That is exactly why the door disappears: the colour matches precisely rather than approximately, the same way it does in the [PERFETTO](/catalog/perfetto) collection, where colour is also made to order.

**Two frames for two kinds of finish.** STANDART is for plaster, for walls that will be painted or papered. LUX is for panelling, where the wall is finished in timber, slats or decorative panels. Choose it together with the wall finish, not after: order the doors when the ceiling and electrics are being planned, or the finished wall will have to be opened up again. The same concealed frame is also available within the [ETALON](/catalog/etalon) collection, with all its other options.

**Five edge options.** The simplest is a primed edge, painted together with the leaf and disappearing entirely. Then an aluminium profile, grey or black: a thin metal line around the perimeter, left visible on purpose as an accent. And the Inside versions with a wider 56 mm profile — the same lines, more pronounced.

**What is not here.** No architrave and no extension — they are not needed, since the frame hides in the wall. A system of aluminium edge profiles is used instead. The frame itself can be painted to a RAL code.

**Sizes.** Width 400–900 mm, height 1800–2100 mm in 50 mm steps, no surcharge. Taller leaves up to 2300 mm are made to order, and floor-to-ceiling height is where concealed doors look their best — one of the trends we cover in ["Interior door trends 2026"](/blog/trendy-mizhkimnatnykh-dverei-2026).
Made at our own plant in Poltava. Doors arrive with hardware already cut in, ready to install.

dveri-pid-farbuvannya-ral.title: Doors Painted to Any RAL or NCS Colour — from the Factory | IN WOOD
dveri-pid-farbuvannya-ral.metaDescription: Interior doors in any RAL or NCS shade: FREZZATTI and PERFETTO collections, frame and architrave to match. Own production, quote within a working day.
dveri-pid-farbuvannya-ral.h1: Doors painted to an exact RAL or NCS colour
body: A ready palette of films covers most jobs, but not all of them. When a design project specifies a colour code, or the door has to disappear into the wall, or the furniture is already made and the door must match it exactly, choosing from a list makes no sense. You need that specific shade.
We paint doors in any RAL or NCS colour. You give the code, we make it.

**What can be painted.** Two collections: [FREZZATTI](/catalog/frezzatti), 14 milled models with relief patterns, and [PERFETTO](/catalog/perfetto), two plain models for minimalist interiors. Separately, there are unfinished leaves for [concealed doors](/catalog/pryhovani-dveri), which you paint after installation together with the wall.

**Not just the leaf.** The frame, architrave and extension are made in the same colour as separate items. This matters: the door reads as a single mass, with no pale frame around a coloured leaf. That is usually the whole point of choosing paint.

**Worth knowing in advance.** There is no finished photograph of the colour, only an indicative sample — no monitor reproduces a shade accurately. Production takes longer than standard and costs more than film. That is the fair price of precision, and it is better known before ordering than after. See ["How to Match Door Colour with Flooring and Furniture"](/blog/yak-pidibraty-kolir-dverei-pid-pidlohu) for more on choosing a colour.
**Sizes** — the standard grid is 400–900 mm wide and 1800–2100 mm high in 50 mm steps, with no size surcharge.
Made at our own factory in Poltava, 20 years in operation. Doors arrive with hardware already cut in.

nestandartni-rozmiry.title: Non-Standard Door Sizes — No Surcharge up to 900×2100 | IN WOOD
nestandartni-rozmiry.metaDescription: Interior doors made to your opening: 400–900 mm wide, 1800–2100 mm high in 50 mm steps with no size surcharge. Wider and taller made to order.
nestandartni-rozmiry.h1: Doors made to your opening, not the other way round
body: A familiar story: the opening is 830 mm. The shop tells you to take 800 and cover the gap with an extension, or take 900 and cut back the wall. Both mean extra work, extra money and a result you can see.

Our size grid runs **in 50 mm steps**: 400, 450, 500 and on up to 900 mm wide, and 1800 to 2100 mm high. **Within that range there is no size surcharge at all.** Not a promotion, not an exception — it is the ordinary list price.
So for an 830 mm opening you take an 800 mm leaf and a normal frame, and the door sits as though the opening had been built for it.

**Wider and taller are made too.** Widths of 950 and 1000 mm and heights of 2150, 2200, 2250 and 2300 mm are made to order at +20% on the leaf price. Non-standard frames and extensions are priced the same way. We say this up front so there is no surprise on the invoice.

**Floor-to-ceiling doors** are worth a separate mention. A 2300 mm leaf changes how a room feels more than any decoration, and looks best in [concealed doors](/catalog/pryhovani-dveri), where there is no frame at all.

**Any size works with any collection** — [ETALON](/catalog/etalon), [NOMINAL](/catalog/nominal), [FREZZATTI](/catalog/frezzatti), [PERFETTO](/catalog/perfetto) and concealed doors. A non-standard size does not limit the model or the colour. See ["How to choose interior doors"](/blog/yak-obraty-mizhkimnatni-dveri) for the bigger picture.
Made at our own factory in Poltava. Doors arrive with hardware cut in, ready to install.

bili-dveri.title: White Interior Doors from the Factory — 4 Shades of White | IN WOOD
bili-dveri.metaDescription: White doors by IN WOOD: plain white, textured white, white oxide, Avignon rustic. All collections, sizes with no surcharge. Quote within a working day.
body: White is chosen more often than every other colour put together — and almost always without noticing that white comes in more than one version.

**We have four.** Plain white is a smooth surface with no texture, the classic for light interiors. Textured white has a noticeable wood-like relief: less like plastic, and better at hiding small marks. White oxide carries a cool greyish undertone and works well beside concrete and grey walls. Avignon rustic white has a pronounced wood structure, for interiors where white should feel warm.
The difference between them is obvious in the hand and invisible on a screen. So if you are choosing white seriously, come to the factory in Poltava and look at them in person.

**Where they are available.** Plain white is in every line — [ETALON](/catalog/etalon), [NOMINAL](/catalog/nominal), FREZZATTI, PERFETTO. Textured and rustic are in ETALON and PERFETTO. White oxide is in NOMINAL and FREZZATTI.
**If you need one specific shade** — matched to the walls or the ceiling, say — we [paint to a RAL or NCS code](/catalog/dveri-pid-farbuvannya-ral). Then the white is exactly the one in your project.

**Honestly about the downside.** White doors show fingerprints sooner than dark ones, smooth surfaces especially. Textured finishes are more practical here. With children or a dog in the house, textures are worth a look.

**Sizes** — 400–900 mm wide, 1800–2100 mm high in 50 mm steps, with no size surcharge. More on matching colour — in the article ["How to Match Door Colour with Flooring and Furniture"](/blog/yak-pidibraty-kolir-dverei-pid-pidlohu).

chorni-dveri.title: Black Interior Doors from the Factory | IN WOOD
chorni-dveri.metaDescription: Black and dark doors: black bark, anthracite, wenge, dark concrete. Black aluminium edging and inlay. Painted to RAL. Quote within a day.
body: Dark doors have stopped being a risk. A few years ago only a handful of people chose them; now it is one of the main directions, and our order book shows it clearly.

**What the palette holds.** Black bark is a deep black with a fine texture, the closest to a true black. Anthracite is a dark grey, softer than black and easier to combine. Southern wenge is dark wood with a pronounced grain. Dark concrete and dark oxide are cool greys for minimalist interiors. Feldgrau is a grey-green, rare and very distinctive.

**Black is not only the leaf.** In the [ETALON](/catalog/etalon) collection the aluminium edging colour is chosen separately — black edging on a light leaf draws a thin graphic line around the perimeter. In the INSIDE version there is also a black decorative inlay on the leaf itself. These are two different devices and they work in entirely different ways.
If you need one specific black, we [paint to a RAL or NCS code](/catalog/dveri-pid-farbuvannya-ral), with the frame and architrave to match.

**Honestly about the downside.** Dark smooth surfaces show dust and marks — no less than white ones, simply differently. Textured finishes such as black bark behave noticeably better than smooth ones.

**Where they are available.** Black bark and dark concrete are in [ETALON](/catalog/etalon) and [PERFETTO](/catalog/perfetto). Anthracite, dark oxide and feldgrau are in NOMINAL and [FREZZATTI](/catalog/frezzatti). Southern wenge is in most lines.
**Sizes** — 400–900 × 1800–2100 mm in 50 mm steps, no surcharge.

specs.value: black bark, anthracite, southern wenge, dark concrete, dark oxide, feldgrau

dveri-pid-derevo.title: Wood-Effect Interior Doors — Oak, Wenge, Pine | IN WOOD
dveri-pid-derevo.metaDescription: Interior doors with wood texture: Chateau oak, Pasadena oak, wenge, Provence pine, Carpathian spruce. Own production, sizes with no surcharge.
body: Solid timber doors cost several times more, need upkeep and cope badly with swings in humidity. A wood-textured film gives the same look with none of those problems — which is why almost everyone who set out to buy "wooden doors" ends up here.

**Oak is the largest group.** Chateau oak is a mid warm tone and the most versatile. Pasadena oak is lighter, with a greyish undertone. Nemo latte oak is a soft beige. Nemo silver oak is a cool grey oak for contemporary interiors. Port oak and Glasgow eco oak are darker, with pronounced grain.
**Dark woods.** Southern wenge and embossed southern wenge are the classic dark timber, the second with a tangible relief.
**Softwood and rustic.** Provence pine is pale, with characteristic knots. Carpathian spruce is warmer and more matt. Golden rustic carries the pronounced structure of aged wood.

**Why texture matters more than colour.** A film embossed to follow the grain differs from a smooth one in more than touch. It catches light differently, and that is what makes the door read as wooden rather than as "an oak-coloured door". Textured finishes have a practical advantage too: small scratches barely show.

**Where they are available.** The widest choice of textures is in [ETALON](/catalog/etalon) and [PERFETTO](/catalog/perfetto), 17 colours. [NOMINAL](/catalog/nominal) and FREZZATTI have 12, mostly oaks and wenge.

**Sizes** — 400–900 × 1800–2100 mm in 50 mm steps, no surcharge. More on matching wood tones — in the article ["How to Match Door Colour with Flooring and Furniture"](/blog/yak-pidibraty-kolir-dverei-pid-pidlohu).

specs.label: Texture groups
specs.value: oak, dark wood (wenge), softwood and rustic

dveri-z-moldyngom.title: Doors with Moulding — 25 Models from the Factory | IN WOOD
dveri-z-moldyngom.metaDescription: Interior doors with moulding: ETALON ET-02 to ET-17 and NOMINAL NL-02 to NL-10. From a single line to complex geometry. Sizes with no surcharge.
body: Moulding is a decorative strip applied to the leaf to create a pattern. It is the most common way to make a door more than a plain rectangle without moving up to the cost of milled or painted finishes.
**Twenty-five models** carry moulding, across two lines: [ETALON](/catalog/etalon), models ET-02 to ET-17, and [NOMINAL](/catalog/nominal), models NL-02 to NL-10.

**The patterns differ in character.** A single vertical line down the centre is the most restrained option and works in almost any interior. Two or three horizontals are quiet and classical. More complex geometry with rectangles and intersections is more expressive, but the room has to carry it.

A simple rule: **the fewer other visual accents a room has, the more complex a pattern it can take.** In a hallway with bare walls, elaborate moulding looks right; in a room with patterned wallpaper it argues with the walls.

**Moulding or milling.** Moulding is applied to the leaf; milling is cut into it. Milling lasts longer — it cannot peel off or be knocked loose by furniture — but costs more. Where a door gets knocked about constantly, [FREZZATTI](/catalog/frezzatti) is worth a look.

**How the lines differ.** ETALON has a 40 mm leaf, 17 colours, and offers aluminium edging, a flush frame and sound insulation. NOMINAL has a 34 mm leaf, 12 colours and only the telescopic frame — at a lower price.
**Sizes** — 400–900 × 1800–2100 mm in 50 mm steps, no surcharge. More on the construction difference — in the article ["Panel vs. stile-and-rail doors"](/blog/shhytovi-chy-tsargovi-dveri).

specs.label: ETALON
specs.value: 40 mm leaf, 17 colours, aluminium edging, flush frame, sound insulation
